name: Mumble Server
description: Official Mumble low-latency, high-quality voice chat server.

paths.name: AppData
paths.description: Persistent Mumble server database and application data. The official image manages ownership of this directory using PUID and PGID.

ports.name: Mumble TCP
ports.description: Mumble TCP connection and control traffic.

ports.name: Mumble UDP
ports.description: Mumble UDP voice traffic. Forward this port when accepting connections from outside the local network.

variables.name: User ID
variables.description: UID used by the Mumble server process and for files in /data. MOS commonly uses UID 500.

variables.name: Group ID
variables.description: GID used by the Mumble server process and for files in /data. MOS commonly uses GID 500.

variables.name: SuperUser Password
variables.description: Optional administrator password for the built-in SuperUser account. If omitted, the container generates one at first startup; check the container logs.

variables.name: Server Password
variables.description: Optional password users must provide to connect to the Mumble server. Leave empty for a server without a connection password.

variables.name: Maximum Users
variables.description: Maximum number of simultaneous users allowed on the server.
